title: Skeletons and Toric Extensions of Maximally Short Complexity One Spaces
summary: Complexity one $T$-spaces are Hamiltonian $T$-spaces $(M,ω,Φ)$ such that $\frac{1}{2}\dim M -\dim T=1$. The skeleton of a complexity one $T$-space is an important invariant in the classification and encodes the information about non-generic orbits. In this paper, we prove that the moment image of the skeleton of a compact, connected maximally short complexity one $T$-space, which is in fact a GKM space, is connected.
